rows.ARS:
Deep pink Floribunda.
Registration name: Pomponella ® (floribunda, Kordes 2005)
rows.Bloom: Deep pink. Mild fragrance. Average diameter 1.5". Small, cluster-flowered, in small clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Small, rounded buds.
rows.Habit:
Bushy, upright. Semi-glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 31" to 6' (80 to 185cm). Width: 2' to 6' (60 to 185cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders. Disease susceptibility: very blackspot resistant., mildew resistant.
rows.Patents:
Australia - Application No: 2010/104 on 20 May 2010 VIEW PBR PATENT
Application withdrawn on August 8, 2011.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes:
Vigorous bed rose with very healthy foliage, a new Fairy Tale Rose, flowering in abundance, the flowers are like the pompons of nostalgic roses.
Participated in the 2012 Glasgow Trials.
